product.name: Monoprice Blackbird 4K30 2x4 Video Splitter And Switch with HDMI
product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™4K HDMI® 2x4 Dual Function Splitter and SwitchDistribute video from either of two sources to four displaysThe Monoprice™ Blackbird™ 4K HDMI® 2x4 Dual Function Splitter and Switch has two HDMI inputs and four HDMI outputs, allowing you to switch between either of two input source devices and send the signal to all four display outputs. It features a built‑in, automatically adjusting video amplifier, which allows you to use longer than normal HDMI cables without any signal loss or degradation.It supports video resolutions up to 4K@60Hz with high‑definition, multichannel audio, including DTS Digital™, Dolby Digital™, DTS-HD Master Audio™, and Dolby TrueHD™, as well as standard 7.1‑channel LPCM stereo. It delivers up to 18Gpbs video bandwidth, supports the YCbCr 4:4:4 color space, and provides basic EDID® management.IMPORTANT: This is NOT a Matrix device and will not allow mixing input sources between output displays. To see various Matrix devices, please click here.Distributes either of two HDMI® sources to all of four HDMI displaysComplies with the HDMI 2.0b and HDCP™ 2.2 specificationsSupports HDMI® resolutions up to 4K@60Hz with the 8‑bit RGB, YCbCr 4:4:4, and YCbCr 4:2:2 color spacesSupports high‑definition digital audio formats, including LPCM 7.1, Dolby Digital™, Dolby TrueHD™, DTS Digital™, and DTS‑HD Master Audio™Supports HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, and Dolby Vision™Includes basic EDID® management EITHER SOURCE TO ALL DISPLAYSThe Blackbird™ 4K HDMI® 2x4 Dual Function Splitter and Switch allows you to distribute either one of two HDMI® sources to all of up to four HDMI display outputs. ULTRA-HIGH-DEFINITION VIDEOThis device supports video resolutions up to 4K@60Hz with up to 18Gbps video bandwidth, ensuring crystal clear, fluid video reproduction. VIVID COLORThe Blackbird™ 4K HDMI® 2x4 Dual Function Splitter and Switch supports the 8-bit RGB, YCbCr 4:4:4, and YCbCr 4:2:2 color spaces with full luminance and chrominance for the optimal viewing experiences of movies, sports, videos, games and digital signage. INTENSE CONTRASTThis devices supports the HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, and Dolby Vision™ High-Dynamic-Range, allowing you can enjoy the beauty of a wider and richer range of colors, much brighter whites, and much deeper and darker blacks. FURIOUS SOUNDThe Blackbird™ 4K HDMI® 2x4 Dual Function Splitter and Switch supports high-definition, multichannel audio, including DTS Digital ™, Dolby Digital™, DTS-HD Master Audio™, and Dolby TrueHD™, as well as standard 7.1-channel LPCM stereo. EDID MANAGEMENTThis device includes basic EDID® management, allowing you to get the EDID settings from the first connected display or use the built-in, basic EDID of 1080p video with 2-channel LPCM audio. .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
